method.description: Investigate whether a nested set of 8, 16, or 32 binary item outcomes predicts an unseen model's full benchmark mean and preserves model rankings better than uniform sampling, a source-mean predictor, response-cluster weighted anchors, and a genuine IRT predictor. The best-shot implementation uses a low-rank source-response representation, diversity-aware anchor selection, and ridge calibration with shrinkage chosen only by grouped cross-validation among source models. Compare against random-anchor and uncalibrated-query-mean ablations. Search develops this method on three Open LLM matrices; final evaluation tests a frozen candidate on ten other original benchmark matrices, including both Open LLM and HELM. The claim concerns these recorded binary matrices, specified model-family splits, and query budgets, not new LLM inference, universal superiority, or guaranteed novelty. Positive, negative, and conditional conclusions are equally acceptable. Superiority requires paired final evidence and uncertainty, not merely winning search; no comparative improvement threshold is a search eligibility gate. Operational refinement: KMeans clustering of normalized response vectors with distinct nearest representatives and population weights is an Anchor Points-style baseline, not an exact fasterpam reproduction; source-only regularized joint 2PL logistic MAP (bounded L-BFGS) is real IRT, not tinyBenchmarks aliasing. Starter diversity embedding uses eigendecomposition and farthest-point nested selection, grouped three-fold ridge/shrinkage grid. Exact source-family discovery is heuristic; fixed benchmark universes and lineage/seed bootstrap do not support population-of-items claims. Frozen primary confirmatory contrast is aggregate candidate-minus-anchor MAE; other comparisons exploratory unless full predeclared 12-contrast Holm alpha .05 familywise rule is applied. Wire schema checks are separate from scientific validity; no reported state flag or changed hash is evidence.

search.precision: uint8 binary responses; float64 CPU numerical methods. CPython 3.11/3.12 Linux x86_64, native-smoke Landlock ABI>=1 and libseccomp.so.2. Evaluator 2 cores/16 GiB; candidate 6 cores/16 GiB. All-thread CPU budget wall_seconds*role_threads. No GPU or network acquisition. Each RPC complete framed message <16 MiB and strictly <64 MiB. Each logical source <=512x16384 uint8, at most two 4 MiB chunks. Native subprocess fresh environment, Landlock read-only runtime/candidate tree and seccomp no network/process creation; broker isolation owned by harness. Monotonic wall includes startup, setup, import, baselines, work, cleanup and writing. Reset=2s; RPC<=30s; episode overhead=8s (candidate terminate/reap 2, stderr 1, baseline terminate/reap 2, stderr 1, baseline thread drain 1, dispatch 1). Candidate and baseline each reserve matched productive work 30s in both planes; no task-declared minimum productive runtime. Conservative startup deduction 60s; finalization 180s. No candidate-internal operation or telemetry claims. Required baseline liveness polled every 50ms during native/broker candidate waits and rechecked on expected RPC failure; original category and numeric exit/signal status frozen before bounded cancellation. Search repair stderr remains bounded; final raw diagnostics remain sealed.

baselines: regularized two-parameter logistic IRT informative anchors
protocol.promotion_rule: Search scientific validity/search_correct requires trusted audited binary/provenance/disjoint content, legal query/RPC/reset/resource boundaries, complete required baselines/episodes, finite probabilities and non-vacuous constant/copy/permutation/terminal reset controls; no comparative performance/adaptivity/significance threshold. Final_correct uses the same validity predicate on final data, not superiority. One invocation includes all cases/seeds/conditions; case order and seed order as reset transcript; conditions primary, constant, copy, permuted, no_diversity, no_calibration, then sole terminal replay. 37 search and 181 final episodes; 7 each smoke. Worst-case RPC table per episode: reset 1, source_chunk maximum 2, fit(commit) 1, observe 3, release 1 = 8; totals 296/1448 and smoke 56. No uncounted export/import/start/commit/replay. Every failed/missing episode retained: MAE/RMSE 1, correlations -1, controls/discrepancy 1; no renormalization. Controls require identical predictions for identical constant/copied queried rows; actual changed roll-one permutation with >=2 distinct vectors; no demanded accuracy degradation. Reset anchors exact and predictions abs tolerance 1e-10. No-diversity anchors equal seeded uniform order and no-calibration predictions equal actual queried means; no algorithm-name/self-report validity evidence. Aggregation rows equal, checkpoints 1/3, seeds equal per case, cases equal per observed family, families equal; replay identity; control types 1/4; missing episodes fixed denominator. combined_score=1-primary MAE. Paired delta failures +1, unsupported CI [-1,1]. Bootstrap 1000 resamples of seeds and global lineage clusters with fixed family/case weights, paired methods; benchmarks fixed, not independent item samples. Search campaign at most three evaluated candidates across three cycles (harness-owned), ranked among correct candidates by combined_score, then lower RMSE, higher Kendall, lexicographic frozen source SHA; final evaluation after immutable freeze only. Negative results eligible; publication assessed separately against complete evidence. No task-local promotion controller. Native smoke is protocol validation, not extra optimization feedback or throughput certification. Qualification feasible reports non-smoke operational completion independently of scientific competitiveness.

search_proxies.name: development-benchmark-universes
search_proxies.preserves: Real binary matrices, grouped unseen-model splits, nested 8/16/32 budgets, four actual baselines, three input controls, two ablations and reset replay; complete fixed failure weights.
search_proxies.omits: Final ten original benchmark universes and HELM family; search uses three audited Open LLM development universes with cross-final document groups removed.

search_proxies.name: draft-smoke
search_proxies.preserves: Same loader, source-only fit, queried response transport, baselines, controls, reset replay, metrics/output path and CPU isolation; exactly first statistical seed and first case.
search_proxies.omits: Full production coverage: at most 24 source rows, 4 target rows, 256 original items. Does not establish final workload throughput or scientific comparisons.

search_visible: Search-only aggregate scalar metrics, evaluator diagnostics needed to repair protocol violations, permitted development split/provenance summaries, and the legal source matrices plus queried target bits for the current search episode.

The fixed method interface, resource limits, search ranking/tie policy, source-only calibration rules, and campaign allowance of three idea cycles with at most one evaluated candidate per cycle; no additional optimizer candidate evaluations through smoke or validation.
final_sealed: Final seed constants and concrete split manifests before freeze, final raw documents/reference answers, unqueried target responses/full target means, final per-model and aggregate metrics, baseline outputs, control outcomes, uncertainty estimates, and failure diagnostics.

Privileged normalization/disjointness audit material containing final content, final smoke artifacts, allocation attestation, and final publication-assessment material; after candidate freeze the harness may use these for reporting, never for another search iteration or candidate RPC scoring feedback.

required_evidence: A real complete research paper in PDF and LaTeX, choosing NeurIPS and the latest official template available when scaffolded, complying with that edition's main-text page limit and required checklist. Include abstract, introduction, related work, method, experiments, discussion, limitations, and real references. Archive the actual template version and provenance downstream; do not invent a template repository/revision at design time. Negative/conditional results are valid outcomes. Candidate-authored sources stay under program_0/src; trusted post-freeze rendering may incorporate sealed evaluator artifacts without feeding those artifacts into candidate RPC or changing the frozen implementation.

Actual source snapshot/license notices, binary-data file digests and observed shapes, safe joblib-loading provenance, supplied metadata inventory verification, exact row/column alignment, and an independently reproducible global normalized raw-document content-hash audit. Record normalization/adapters before splitting, cross-ID and reordered-choice duplicate checks, source IDs, lineage/alias grouping, row provenance, seeds, split manifests, and all search removals. Demonstrate zero search/final raw-content overlap across source and target examples; dataset IDs/directories and supplied doc_hash fields alone are insufficient. Report any incomplete metadata and prohibit unsupported clean-split claims.

Executable reproducible code, exact standard-scaffold dependency versions, offline wheel/platform setup, acquisition instructions requiring no account or paid API, run commands, seeds, and expected times labeled as estimates until measured. Name the script generating every reported table and figure. Prefer standard scaffold files for dependency and provenance declarations; no extra support file is currently required. If downstream implementation genuinely needs one, first name its concrete task-relative path in contract provenance, hash its actual bytes, and resynchronize the contract after relevant changes.

Downstream contract preflight proving candidate boundary/isolation, no private labels or scoring feedback in RPC, no shared-file transport, finite base64/dtype/shape encodings, and serialized byte counts for the largest actual and capped requests/responses including UTF-8 JSON, base64 expansion, envelope metadata, and framing. Demonstrate each complete message is strictly below 64 MiB and show chunk-memory bounds plus counted chunk RPCs within 296 search, 1448 final, and 56 per smoke. These are planned obligations, not claims of completed preflight.

Production and smoke broker evidence matching the exact four declared reset arrays, one reset per independent episode, the sole terminal replay after all ordinary episodes, and correct episode/seed/case coverage across reconnects and restarts. Trusted isolation and resource attestations should distinguish wall-clock and all-thread CPU limits, broker RPC enforcement, and item-query limits from advisory candidate-internal fit/optimizer counts. Do not infer a hard internal compute cap from numeric iteration settings or candidate counters. Include setup, baseline, candidate fitting, predictions, aggregation, cancellation, and cleanup costs; smoke does not attest the full production run.

Actual runs of uniform/source-mean, response-cluster weighted-anchor, and genuine IRT baselines, source-only cross-validation, submitted-method selection/calibration branches, and actual no-diversity/no-calibration ablations. Provide evaluator-owned small-fixture validation and frozen-source review sufficient to establish that the claimed computations run rather than aliases. Report all required baseline failures, budget exhaustion, omitted-by-failure work, and finite worst-case contributions; no unannounced replacement baselines, dropped cases/controls, or renormalized surviving weights.

Predeclared negative controls and expected structural behavior, matched permitted inputs and budgets, actual changed nonidentity permutations, constant/copied-input prediction checks, and the single terminal reset reproducibility comparison. A vacuous or failed control cannot establish a causal conclusion; a chance permutation improvement is not automatically invalid. Keep scientific validity gates, search eligibility, and final publication-claim assessment separate. Record the three-evaluation campaign, deterministic ranking/ties, selected source digest, and irrevocable freeze before any final-resource exposure.

Trusted evaluator-owned per-checkpoint/per-model predictions and private full-score comparisons, all 37 search or 181 final episode statuses, exact scalar metrics.json objects, fixed aggregation weights, per-case/per-budget error and ranking tables, paired baseline differences, model/content-cluster-aware uncertainty, and limitations of only two search/three final split seeds. Validate the multiplicity rule before final scoring. Complete positive claims require relevant full paired evidence, non-tradeable integrity checks, and appropriate uncertainty; an aggregate win alone is insufficient. Bound conclusions to the audited development universes and original full final benchmarks, binary outcomes, source-model coverage, and held-out model-family protocol.

Every number, figure, table, checkpoint, hash claimed as run evidence, and empirical timing in the paper must come from actual supplied inputs or later executed reproducible work. Do not present planned budgets, smoke checks, estimated throughput, synthetic demonstrations, or incomplete runs as production results. Preserve failures, abandoned ideas, uncertainty, and unfinished work explicitly. All design-time quantities here are allocations/protocol choices unless explicitly identified as input digests or supplied provenance.

Respect the task's independent-research exclusion: do not identify, search for, access, or use the prohibited paper, its mirrors, associated material/code, or pages citing/discussing/reproducing it. Use only the explicitly permitted starter literature and unrelated sources; inspect the named permitted data/method source without following arbitrary citation links. If prohibited material is encountered accidentally, stop reading immediately and truthfully record where it appeared and how much was seen. Cite only real works actually consulted; do not assert novelty without a compliant literature assessment.

Operational correctness does not render or review a paper: genuine latest-official-template PDF/LaTeX, checklist, actual inspected literature, method source review and table/figure reproduction remain publication obligations. Data/family adapters are heuristic and must not be advertised as complete lineage proof. Preserved point predictions are not automatically a population-of-items or universal-superiority claim.
